versions.changelog:
Major update: Adds multi-source policy scraping, advanced filtering, and automated summaries.

- Supports automated scraping of vocational education policy documents and project announcements from national and provincial government sites.
- Enables keyword, category, date range, and source-based filtering.
- Introduces periodic summaries and report generation (daily/weekly/monthly/by region or topic).
- Enhanced CLI usability with Chinese and English language support.
- Includes resource documentation for technical details, internationalization, and custom website configuration.
- Notes ClawHub display name limitations and slug formatting requirements.
